$comment: Peptide Connect constellation mark — geometry reconstructed from the approved 1254x1254 icon (peptide-connect-icon.png) via pixel erosion + connected-components analysis. Coordinates are NORMALIZED to a 0..100 viewbox (top-left origin). This is the single source of truth for every logo variant and favicon. DO NOT introduce a 5th node, a hexagon frame, or a flower — the mark is 4 asymmetric nodes + 5 straight strokes + 1 navy anchor.

colors.note: Brand palette tokens are #102D38 / #12A89D per the approved kit. Measured raster samples were navy ~rgb(7,51,72), teal ~rgb(1,180,184). Vector uses brand tokens; measured values kept for QA comparison.

wordmark.note: PEPTIDE and CONNECT stacked, bold, uppercase. CONNECT is letter-spaced (tracked). PEPTIDE takes the primary color (navy on light / white on dark / currentColor in mono), CONNECT takes teal. In the horizontal layout the icon sits left of a two-line stack.
